bio_en: Astvatsatur Mirzayan, called Kretatsi, was the son of vine-growers in Kizlyar and attended the town school until the Russian government closed all Armenian schools of the Caucasus in March 1885. Conscripted in 1882, he was soon sent to a junior military school, learning soldiering that he later turned against another enemy. In March 1897 he left his aged parents on the pretext of finding work in Baku and joined the force for the Khanasor expedition. In the evening retreat he was among the last, covering the victorious force with Karo Zorian, and fell there with him.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: high. Years 1871-1897 from the title; conscription year 1882 as given.
